Inside and out

Room to settle in.

A furnished home with two bedrooms, a dedicated office and private outdoor space.

Made for a longer stay

Equipped for work and downtime.

The condo has three rooms total: a king bedroom, queen bedroom and dedicated home office. The full bath includes a tub; the living room has a sofa bed.

Work-ready

  • Large desk, ergonomic chair and gaming chair
  • External monitor and laptop stand
  • Printer and surge protector
  • up to 1 Gbps (1 gig) high-speed internet
  • Private entrance and driveway parking

Kitchen & laundry

  • Frigidaire refrigerator
  • Stainless gas stove and oven
  • Dishwasher and microwave
  • Cookware, dishware, French press and kettle
  • In-unit washer and dryer

Comfort & outdoor

  • Central air conditioning and heating
  • Large private patio, gas grill and dining set
  • 65-inch HDTV, Chromecast and premium cable
  • Bluetooth soundbar, record player, books and exercise bike
  • Free street parking, bikes and beach essentials

Also nearby: a gym 2–3 minutes away with month-to-month memberships. Housekeeping can be arranged for $100 per visit. Safety equipment includes smoke and CO alarms, fire extinguisher, first aid kit and exterior security cameras.

Connected Jamaica Plain location

Neighborhood calm, Boston within reach.

The home is the last house on a dead-end street, so there's no through traffic — making the street even quieter.

  • 5 minwalk to Franklin Park, public golf course, tennis courts & Forest Hills Cemetery
  • 10–12minute walk to Green St or Forest Hills Orange Line stations
  • 10–15minute walk to Centre Street restaurants and coffee shops
  • ~20 minto downtown Boston via Orange Line

Well placed for hospital assignments

Reach the Longwood Medical Area and hospitals across Boston with the Orange Line nearby. When the shift is over, Franklin Park is about a five-minute walk from home.

The patio faces the private parking lot, not the street.
